newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's HACTL nears air cargo handling record.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's HACTL nears air cargo handling record.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL) said on Thursday it is nearing a new air cargo handling record with cumulative throughput for the first eight months of this year rising 3.6 percent to 918,326 tonnes.

HACTL exports rose 2.4 percent to 416,201 tonnes, imports climbed 5.9 percent to 393,074 tonnes and transhipments remained relatively static at 109,051 tonnes for the period from January 1 to August 31 this year, it said in a statement.

August statistics continued the modest upward trend with exports increasing 3.3 percent to 61,186 tonnes, imports soaring 11.1 percent to 49,120 tonnes and transhipments also gaining 4.2 percent to 15,178 tonnes.

"We are confident that the figures will continue to climb in the next few months as factories in both Hong Kong and southern China gear up to meet client deadlines for the all-important Christmas period," said Anthony Charter, HACTL managing director.

HACTL is 25 percent held by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, 20 percent by Swire Pacific Ltd, 12.5 percent by Wharf (Holdings) Ltd, 12.5 percent by Hutchinson Whampoa Ltd and 10 percent each by CITIC Pacific Ltd, China National Aviation Corp and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd.
